rows.Kwic: 師乃舉起拂子云：看！看！喚作拂子，觸目有滯；不喚作拂子，亦乃觸目有滯。
rows.sourceTitle: 超宗慧方禪師語錄（黃龍四家錄第四）

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chaozong Huifang (超宗慧方禪師語錄（黃龍四家錄第四）): in his Heshan record, Chaozong Huifang raises the whisk and says both naming and not naming it obstruct what meets the eye.
